scripts.josephus:
def solve(inputs: dict) -> float:
    n = inputs['N']
    k = inputs['K']
    
    # Create a list of people numbered 1 to n
    people = list(range(1, n + 1))
    
    # Start at position 0
    current_pos = 0
    
    # Remove people until only one remains
    while len(people) > 1:
        # Count k positions (with wraparound)
        current_pos = (current_pos + k - 1) % len(people)
        # Remove the person at this position
        people.pop(current_pos)
        # Adjust position if we removed the last element
        if current_pos >= len(people) and len(people) > 0:
            current_pos = 0
    
    return float(people[0])
